text:
Platinum grading for AP State in December 2023
As of 20th December, 2023,

168 districts of States of which AP is part have completed 99% and above of  the work on six components.

As per 2023-24 annual report of Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India, 

Andhra Pradesh is amongst the States that completed more than 90% of the work with respect to the following. 

Computerization of land records
Digitization of Cadastral Maps
Integration of Cadastral Maps with RORs
Computerization of Registration
Integration of land records and property registration

Incentive receipt by Government of AP
Rs. 397.72 crores was received by Government of AP from the Central Government owing to fulfilment of milestone I.

It is admirable that only AP State could obtain incentive on account of milestone I. 

The PIB notification and content from the Ministry’s annual report  in previous slide indicates fulfillment of requirements in all four clauses of Milestone-I by before April, 2024 itself.
Release of funds
Guidelines
